SubspaceAD_native_fp16.rect_justification: the HF image processor is called with do_resize=True, size={height:image_res,width:image_res}, do_center_crop=False (docrop is a separate flag and stays off), i.e. every image is stretched to a square image_res x image_res before patch embedding, so the (h_p,w_p) grid spans the whole original image. A full-image rect is a superset of every frozen method's rect and therefore does NOT shrink the shared intersection.

resolution_decision.reason: measured on this machine: at image_res=672 the same single unit could not finish 12 query images in 15+ minutes (GPU 5797/6144 MiB, WDDM paging; the plan warns about 250 s/img under eviction), while at 256 the unit runs at 0.42 s/img with a 2266 MB peak. image_res=256 is also the configuration of the project's existing SubspaceAD runs (scripts/validation_handoff_20260911/e3_subspacead_full.py never overrides main.py's --image_res default of 256).
resolution_decision.status: recorded deviation, NOT a silent downgrade; both the resolution and the fact that it differs from the upstream 672 script are stored in DONE.json and must appear in the table note

other_deviations: support identities from the frozen project manifest instead of upstream random.shuffle(train)[:k] (house convention: one support set per unit across all compared methods)
upstream aug_count=30 rotate augmentation of the few-shot script is off (VRAM budget)
fp16 (--smoke_half equivalent), as in the project's existing SubspaceAD runs

If the checkpoints are project-trained rather than the upstream release, the column must be labelled 'auxiliary-domain trained, zero-shot on the target' and needs the author's sign-off.

gate_result: SubspaceAD: PASS (empirical). WinCLIP+: PASS (source + empirical). AnomalyCLIP zero-shot: PASS with a checkpoint-provenance caveat that needs an author decision. No method was dropped from P1.
region_identity_finding: All three new methods have rect [0,1]x[0,1] because each of them stretches the image to a square (SubspaceAD: HF processor do_resize to image_res x image_res with do_center_crop=False; WinCLIP: transforms.Resize((240,240)) + CenterCrop(240); AnomalyCLIP: Resize((518,518)) + CenterCrop(518)). Their rectangles are supersets of every frozen method's rectangle, so the shared intersection is unchanged: 36/36 (dataset, category) groups have identical region_rect and region_grid to the frozen common_region_geometry.json, and the frozen six columns were reproduced with 0 mismatches in both the joint nine-method run and the six-method replay (see EXT_CHECKS.json).
constraints_respected: one heavy GPU method at a time (single 6 GiB card, 4-5 GiB usable host RAM)
the frozen 864-row table is never written to; its sha256 is re-read after every stage
no unit is ever silently skipped: failures are appended to <method>/<method>_failures.json and to _RUN_LOG.txt
